surah.personality_title: Surah Al-Haqqah (The Indubitable Reality, The Eight Bearers of the Throne & The Severing of the Aorta)
surah.personality_summary: Autonomous Qur'anic surah possessing a distinctive theological axis, spiritual atmosphere, and structural cadence.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Haaqqa (The Reality) is the 69th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 52 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Inevitable Reality
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The Inevitable Hour

ayahs.translation_saheeh: What is the Inevitable Reality
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: What is the Inevitable Hour

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: What will explain to you what the Inevitable Hour is

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Thamud and 'Aad denied the Striking Calamity
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The people of Thamud and 'Ad denied that the crashing blowwould come

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So as for Thamud, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Thamud was destroyed by a deafening blast

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَمَّا عَادࣱ فَأُهۡلِكُواْ بِرِيحࣲ صَرۡصَرٍ عَاتِيَةࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واما عاد فاهلكوا بريح صرصر عاتية
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And as for 'Aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Ad was destroyed by a furious wind

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَبۡعَ لَيَالࣲ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومࣰ اۖ فَتَرَى ٱلۡقَوۡمَ فِيهَا صَرۡعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٍ خَاوِيَةࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَانِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى الْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: سخرها عليهم سبع ليال وثمانية ايام حسوما فترى القوم فيها صرعى كانهم اعجاز نخل خاوية
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that God let loose against them for seven consecutive nights, eight consecutive days, so that you could have seen its people lying dead like hollow palm-trunks

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then do you see of them any remains
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Can you see any trace of them now

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَجَآءَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَمَن قَبۡلَهُۥ وَٱلۡمُؤۡتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلۡخَاطِئَةِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَجَاءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَنْ قَبْلَهُ وَالْمُؤْتَفِكَاتُ بِالْخَاطِئَةِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وجاء فرعون ومن قبله والمؤتفكات بالخاطئة
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Pharaoh, too, and those before him, and the ruined cities: these people committed grave sins

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَعَصَوۡاْ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ أَخۡذَةࣰ رَّابِيَةً
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَعَصَوْا رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَابِيَةً
ayahs.arabic_clean: فعصوا رسول ربهم فاخذهم اخذة رابية
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an ever-tightening grip

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلۡمَآءُ حَمَلۡنَٰكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡجَارِيَةِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَى الْمَاءُ حَمَلْنَاكُمْ فِي الْجَارِيَةِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انا لما طغى الماء حملناكم في الجارية
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But when the Flood rose high, We saved you in the floating ship

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لِنَجۡعَلَهَا لَكُمۡ تَذۡكِرَةࣰ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنࣱ وَٰعِيَةࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَا أُذُنٌ وَاعِيَةٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لنجعلها لكم تذكرة وتعيها اذن واعية
ayahs.translation_saheeh: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: making that event a reminder for you: attentive ears may take heed

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ نَفۡخَةࣱ وَٰحِدَةࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاذا نفخ في الصور نفخة واحدة
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When the Trumpet is sounded a single time

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَحُمِلَتِ الْأَرْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَاحِدَةً
ayahs.arabic_clean: وحملت الارض والجبال فدكتا دكة واحدة
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when the earth and its mountains are raised high and then crushed with a single blow

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then on that Day, the Resurrection will occur
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: on that Day the Great Event will come to pass

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The sky will be torn apart on that Day, it will be so frail

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلۡمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرۡجَآئِهَاۚ وَيَحۡمِلُ عَرۡشَ رَبِّكَ فَوۡقَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ ثَمَٰنِيَةࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَالْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰ أَرْجَائِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَانِيَةٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: والملك على ارجائها ۚ ويحمل عرش ربك فوقهم يومئذ ثمانية
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The angels will be on all sides of it and, on that Day, eight of them will bear the throne of your Lord above them

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَوۡمَئِذࣲ تُعۡرَضُونَ لَا تَخۡفَىٰ مِنكُمۡ خَافِيَةࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنْكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يومئذ تعرضون لا تخفى منكم خافية
ayahs.translation_saheeh: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: On that Day you will be brought to judgement and none of your secrets will remain hidden

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقۡرَءُواْ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ فَيَقُولُ هَاؤُمُ اقْرَءُوا كِتَابِيَهْ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاما من اوتي كتابه بيمينه فيقول هاؤم اقرءوا كتابيه
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Anyone who is given his Record in his right hand will say, ‘Here is my Record, read it

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I knew I would meet my Reckoning,’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So he will be in a pleasant life
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and so he will have a pleasant life

ayahs.translation_saheeh: In an elevated garden
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: in a lofty Garden

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: with clustered fruit within his reach

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَآ أَسۡلَفۡتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَيَّامِ ٱلۡخَالِيَةِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِي الْأَيَّامِ الْخَالِيَةِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: كلوا واشربوا هنيئا بما اسلفتم في الايام الخالية
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: It will be said, ‘Eat and drink to your heart’s content as a reward for what you have done in days gone by.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي لَمۡ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِشِمَالِهِ فَيَقُولُ يَا لَيْتَنِي لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَابِيَهْ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واما من اوتي كتابه بشماله فيقول يا ليتني لم اوت كتابيه
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But anyone who is given his Record in his left hand will say, ‘If only I had never been given any Record

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And had not known what is my account
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and knew nothing of my Reckoning

ayahs.translation_saheeh: I wish my death had been the decisive one
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: How I wish death had been the end of me

ayahs.translation_saheeh: My wealth has not availed me
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: My wealth has been no use to me

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Gone from me is my authority
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and my power has vanished.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Take him, put a collar on him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then into Hellfire drive him
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: lead him to burn in the blazing Fire

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ فِي سِلۡسِلَةࣲ ذَرۡعُهَا سَبۡعُونَ ذِرَاعࣰ ا فَٱسۡلُكُوهُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: ثُمَّ فِي سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَاسْلُكُوهُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ثم في سلسلة ذرعها سبعون ذراعا فاسلكوه
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and [bind him] in a chain seventy metres long

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انه كان لا يؤمن بالله العظيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah, the Most Great
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: he would not believe in Almighty God

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: he never encouraged feeding the hungry

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: so today he has no real friend here

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the only food he has is the filth

ayahs.translation_saheeh: None will eat it except the sinners
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that only sinners eat.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So I swear by what you see
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So I swear by what you can see

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And what you do not see
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and by what you cannot see

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is the word of a noble Messenger
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: this [Quran] is the speech of an honoured messenger

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَاعِرࣲۚ قَلِيلࣰ ا مَّا تُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَا تُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما هو بقول شاعر ۚ قليلا ما تؤمنون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: not the words of a poet- how little you believe

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَا بِقَوۡلِ كَاهِنࣲۚ قَلِيلࣰ ا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولا بقول كاهن ۚ قليلا ما تذكرون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: nor the words of a soothsayer- how little you reflect

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This [Quran] is a message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And if Muhammad had made up about Us some [false] sayings
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: if [the Prophet] had attributed some fabrication to Us

ayahs.translation_saheeh: We would have seized him by the right hand
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We would certainly have seized his right hand

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then We would have cut from him the aorta
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and cut off his lifeblood

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ عَنۡهُ حَٰجِزِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَمَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَاجِزِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فما منكم من احد عنه حاجزين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and none of you could have defended him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This [Quran] is a reminder for those who are aware of God

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We know that some of you consider it to be lies

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: this will be a source of bitter regret for the disbelievers

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but it is in fact the certain Truth

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So [Prophet] glorify the name of your Lord, the Almighty
